reader.notes: PresentLine sets LINE-COUNTER to each line's number before composing it and nothing resets it after the page heading, so the final setting is the last print line. A page heading with no LINE clause is ended in BeginGroup before any line, leaving LINE-COUNTER alone. The 3.10.7 text is reconstructed (PB4952); the printed LINE-COUNTER rules XIII.3.5.6 GR5/GR6 agree.
